notes.title: Primal Lands Update V2.0
notes.content:
Primal Lands Update V2.0
World Additions

Added additional movement directions for tribe members from four directions to eight, this allows pathfinding to be more diverse in traversing the land.
Added additional water patterns to include up to sixteen different varieties of water flow.
Added a new unique map and split the current map into its own unique map. 

Mont Land

Mont Land is still the starting map and is generally the best map to play in terms of learning the basics of the game. 
Resoures: Wood, stone, fish, berries and meat.
Enemies: Deer, saber tooth tiger, wolves, rhino and mammoth.
Generation: Trees, rivers, large rivers, stone, bushes and tribes.

Safari Desert

Safari Desert is generally a slightly harder to survive map as it is set out in the desert with hard to find resources and only the hardest hostile animals will spawn.
Resoures: Wood, stone, fish, berries and meat.
Enemies: Saber tooth tiger, wolves, rhino and mammoth.
Generation: Broken trees, stone and tribes.

Command Posts
Command posts are locked to the numpad (1 blue, 2 red, 3 green and 4 orange). You can now assign forteers to a command post by highlighting them with the Urok hand and clicking them in which they will be highlighted. You can unassign a tribe member by right clicking them in which they will return to their building. You can clear a command post by using (numpad 0) with a post highlighted in urok hand.

Worship Points and Urok Hand
Introducing worship points, each tribe members has an oppertunity to worship you as a god and increase your points. Points can now be spent on casting spells such as fire and water in future updates we will update a full skill tree which will use this feature.

New Animals
We have added wolves and rhinos to the mix of our already expanding animal kingdom.

Wolves - will attack any tribe member in range and call nearby wolves to help them strike their targets. Wolves at night will also call out to summon more wolves.

Rhinos  - will attack directly in front of them charging and taking out any nearby object, animal or tribe member.

Other Additions

Added addition spawn generation for tree placement to make maps feel more dense.
Added a new building ForteerShack - this costs 20 wood to build and allows tribe members to be controlled to attack certain locations using the new command posts.
Added new command posts to direct your forteer tribe members.
Added tribe member sorting and viewing panel.
Added healing for tribe members under 50 percent of there overall health.
Added enemy tribes camp fire to show light for the player.
Added enemy tribes camp fire now destroys after killing the enemy tribe nearby.
Added outline to tribe members that you're currently hovering over.
Added tribe members death by diseases.

Changes

	Changes made to accessing the options menu, this will now pause the game until you exit the menu.
	Changes made to tribes movement pattern to become less restricted in certain circumstances.
	Changed number 1 and 2 to remain as slow and fast speeds.

Bug Fixes

    Fixed an issue with load game not appearing when saving from Creative or Survival.
	Fixed an issue with music speeding up with the simulation speed.
	Fixed an issue with slider for music volume in controls.
	Fixed an issue with pausing the game would continue you to play tribal dance music.
	Fixed an issue with pausing the game would still continue Tri-AI pathfinding.
	Fixed an issue with changing speed during pause menu would cause issues with Tri-AI.
	Fixed an issue with water tiling to become incomplete with unknown values of water flow.
	Fixed an issue with water tiling to overlap.
	Fixed an issue with water endings to join a pre-existing water flow.
	Fixed an issue with debug movement still remaining in some instances.
	Fixed an issue with enemy tribes not attacking tribe members with jobs.
	Fixed an issue with pathfinding becoming corrupt after placing a tribe member a far distance from camp fire.
	Fixed an issue with days survived would start from the 5th day rather then the 1st.
	Fixed an issue with Urok hand lighting to vanish after changing generation in creative mode.
	Fixed an issue with Enemy tribes spawning without camp fire.
	Fixed an issue with Enemy tribes camp fire despawning when the day ends.
	Fixed an issue with tribe members becoming locked in survival when story dialog was being shown.
	Fixed an issue with destroying a building that contained a builder would stop you from building.
	Fixed an issue with changing settings in the creative tab would reset speed back to the default speed.
	Fixed an issue with health bar still visible after closing peep.
	Fixed an issue with adjusting sound in-game wouldn't save properly.
	Fixed an issue with loading previous audio setting during in-game.
	Fixed an issue with tribes death not removing perimeter of detection.
	Fixed an issue with building menu not displaying correct tab upon closing and reopening.
	Fixed an issue with destroying buildings would cause worker icon to be visible and remain in position.
	Fixed an issue with using fire power would sometimes freeze trees behavior.


I'm just finalizing any last issues and hopefully this update will be with you on Monday. Thanks for waiting!

Kind Regards
Brett ːflmayorː

notes.title: Primal Lands Update - V0.0.1
notes.content:
Primal Lands Update V0.0.1
Optimized Code

	Updated internal software and compiler using the newer steam SDK.

New Features

	Added Enemy tribes, enemy tribes will now set up a camp that is not occupied by another tribe.
	Note: Enemy tribes will visit during the night and set up a camp, enemy camp fires will not emit any light or heat for your tribe members.
	Enemy tribes can only attack tribe members that are currently not in a job, this is until we implement tribe members that can protect your territory and guard other tribe members.
    Added Tribe death, tribe members will now die from starvation, heatstroke or hypothermia.
	Note: Tribe members being attacked by enemies will also need to heal to stop bleeding out. When all tribe members are dead, your game will end choose to fight wisely!
	Added Tribe health meter to Tribe Statistics HUD.
	Note: Health meter will appear disfunctional if the tribe member is currently in diseased status.
	Added Tribe hover and worker icons for both stonemason, forestry and quarry buildings.
	Added Music to tribal dance, tribe members will now perform a rhythmic dance. Tribe members will only be recruited if the dance is identical if not be prepared to fight them!
	Added Gameover screen when all your tribe has died which displays have many days you managed to survive.
	Added Restore to default settings in the options menu.
	Note: If none of your controls are working please using this feature as it will correct these issues.
	Added Font size for tooltips video settings in the options menu. (Please note this does not affect build menu or resources menu) - (Suggested by: Monkofmimmir)
	Added Spawning for mammals that have despawned or been killed.
	Added Destroy Buildings, there is now a new icon to the building menu to which you can now right click and destroy buildings.
	Note: You will not obtain any resource back from built building, this will be in the next update.
	Added Creative option to disable enemy tribes from spawning.
	Added More keyboard keys for control options.
	Added More tree textures to give more variety in placement.
	Added Pause option to speed settings (Pause/x1/x5/x10/x20) - Following key changes below keys are ([ / ]) to adjust speed.
	Added Save game/Load game option only one save can be made per game mode (Survival and Creative). Load game will only be visible when you have at least one saved game.

Bug Fixes

    Fixed an issue with tribe drag option not removing whilst using in-game menu.
	Fixed an issue with camera sensitivity option being locked due to incorrect value.
	Fixed an issue with steam overlay not working properly.
	Fixed an issue with picking up tribe members whilst navigating the options menu.
	Fixed an issue with mammals leaving the land but not despawning.
	Fixed an issue with player camera moving to fast resulting in a white screen.
	Fixed an issue with arrows overlaying tribe members during a tribal war.
	Fixed an issue with changes to audio settings whilst in-game would not change volume until the current session was ended.
	Fixed an issue with exiting a game and replaying another would cause lighting to resume.
	Fixed an issue with tutorial rescue could become stuck during tribal dance.
	Fixed an issue with HUD during creative mode that would cause creation tab to glitch.
	Fixed an issue with Tribe collision detection slightly offset.
	Fixed an issue with Tribe hunger and temperature HUD not displaying properly. 
	Fixed an issue with Urok hand collision not detecting cursor speed and position properly.
	Fixed an issue with Exiting during a playthrough would cause time to stop functioning correctly.
	Fixed an issue with Tribe exiting out during a tribal dance and clothing wouldn't stay in one place.
	Fixed an issue with Music not playing properly when reloading a map.
	Fixed an issue with Audio playback only playing at a selected location.
	Fixed an issue with Music not changing after playing once.

Changes

	Changes made for Deer AI to now eat berries from bushes that are not being occupied by tribe members.
	Changes made for Animal AI to detect blood in distance to tribe members.
	Changes made for spawning mammals on generation. (Mammals will be restricted to deers for the first five days of playtime)
	Changes made for cloud generation and movement. 
	Changes made for speed up and down key commands from (- / + to [ / ])
	Changes made for steam overlay to bring up community hub tab for direct feedback.
	Changes made to water texture to seem more integrated with the land.

Removal

	Removed development double clicking from spawning enemy tribes.
	Removed development option with being able to bring up debug console.
	Removed development faster speed options / shortcuts being used.
	Removed unused code.
